name: E09 EN — caller wants a human immediately
simulation_scenario: You are an English-speaking caller in Laval, and you speak ONLY English, start to finish. You do not want to talk to an automated agent at all. Open with exactly: "Agent. Representative." If the agent asks what you need, answer only: "A person. Now." Keep asking until it transfers you: "Just get me a human." You never say what your question is about, and you are not abusive — just blunt and in a hurry.
success_conditions: The agent transferred the call — it used the transfer system tool — without arguing and without trying to handle the request itself.
The agent asked at most one short clarifying question before transferring.
G1 — Every agent turn is in the caller's current language (French while the caller speaks French, English while the caller speaks English).

G2 — The agent did not invent facts. Recalls, VIN details, free slots and booking references must come from a tool call in this conversation. Dealer facts are allowed only if they match this list: open Mon–Fri 7:00–18:00, Sat 8:00–14:00, closed Sunday; free shuttle within 10 km, Mon–Fri 7:30–16:30, none on Saturday; free loaner on request for jobs over 3 hours (licence, credit card, age 21+); winter tires mandatory in Quebec Dec 1–Mar 15; winter tire season Oct 1–Dec 15; mount+balance 4 winter tires $129, mount only $79, wheel swap $69; tire storage $89 per season (Nov 1–Apr 30); multi-point inspection free with any service; recall repairs free; oil change from $69 (about 45 min); diagnostic $129 (about 1 h, credited if the repair is done); cancellation free up to 24 h before, else $75; first date change free; payment by Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Interac, cash in person; no payment or card number over the phone; prices before tax; all makes serviced; address boulevard Le Corbusier, Laval, near Highway 15 and boulevard Saint-Martin; no bodywork, glass or towing. Also allowed (FAQ elaborations): the inspection covers 42 points (brakes, tires, steering, suspension, battery, lighting, leaks, fluid levels, belts, air-conditioning condition) with a report by email or text and a call before any repair; stored tires are washed and labelled with the customer's name; free customer parking; waiting room with coffee and Wi-Fi; text reminder 48 h before the appointment; repair financing over $500 through a partner; original or equivalent parts; electric vehicles serviced for tires, brakes and general maintenance; quoted prices are before GST 5% and QST 9.975%. Any other price or policy stated as fact is a fail. Small talk does not count.
